name: generate-commit
description: Generate Conventional Commits messages from your staged diff using AI providers (OpenRouter, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, Claude Code CLI, Codex CLI).

generateCommit.provider.markdownDescription: Active provider used to generate commit messages. Unavailable providers fall back to the first available one.

generateCommit.language.markdownDescription: Language of the generated commit message (e.g. `en`, `pt-BR`, `es`, `fr`).

generateCommit.maxDiffChars.markdownDescription: Maximum number of characters of the diff sent to the provider. The diff is truncated at file boundaries and the truncation is flagged in the prompt.

generateCommit.maxFileSizeKB.markdownDescription: Files whose diff chunk exceeds this size (KB) are excluded from the prompt.

generateCommit.includeRecentCommits.markdownDescription: Include the 10 most recent commit subjects as style context.

generateCommit.customPrompt.markdownDescription: Extra instructions appended to the system prompt (e.g. project-specific conventions).

generateCommit.unstagedFallback.markdownDescription: What to do when the staged diff is empty: ask to use unstaged changes, always use them, or never.

generateCommit.timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Timeout (seconds) for provider HTTP requests and CLI executions.

generateCommit.openrouter.model.markdownDescription: Model ID for OpenRouter (verified on https://openrouter.ai/models at 2026-08-02).

generateCommit.openrouter.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible OpenRouter API. HTTPS only.

generateCommit.kimi.model.markdownDescription: Model ID for Kimi / Moonshot AI (verified at 2026-08-02). Avoid `kimi-k2.7-code`: it rejects requests without thinking enabled.

generateCommit.kimi.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the Kimi Anthropic-compatible API (China: `https://api.moonshot.cn/anthropic`). HTTPS only.

generateCommit.glm.model.markdownDescription: Model ID for GLM / z.ai (verified at 2026-08-02: `glm-5.2`, `glm-4.7`, `glm-4.5-air`).

generateCommit.glm.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the z.ai Anthropic-compatible API. HTTPS only.

generateCommit.minimax.model.markdownDescription: Model ID for MiniMax (verified at 2026-08-02: `MiniMax-M3`, `MiniMax-M2.7`, `MiniMax-M2.5`, and `-highspeed` variants).

generateCommit.minimax.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the MiniMax Anthropic-compatible API (China: `https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic`). HTTPS only.

generateCommit.anthropicCustom.model.markdownDescription: Model ID for the generic Anthropic-compatible endpoint.

generateCommit.anthropicCustom.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of any Anthropic-compatible endpoint (the client posts to `<baseUrl>/v1/messages`). HTTPS only.

generateCommit.anthropicCustom.authHeade.markdownDescription: Authentication header style for the custom Anthropic-compatible endpoint: `x-api-key` (Anthropic) or `bearer` (`Authorization: Bearer`).

generateCommit.claudeCli.model.markdownDescription: Model for the Claude Code CLI (`--model`). Empty uses the CLI default. Accepts aliases (`sonnet`, `opus`, `fable`) or full IDs (verified with `claude --help` 2.1.220 at 2026-08-02).

generateCommit.claudeCli.effort.markdownDescription: Effort level for the Claude Code CLI (`--effort`). Empty uses the CLI default.

generateCommit.codexCli.model.markdownDescription: Model for the Codex CLI (`--model`). Empty uses the CLI default.

generateCommit.codexCli.effort.markdownDescription: Reasoning effort for the Codex CLI, passed as `-c model_reasoning_effort="<value>"` (verified in the official config reference at 2026-08-02).
